D3·pbbp — 2026-10-06
chose: U6 write-back semantics (0.34.1). `sofar_end_session` and `sofar event append` file every valid entry and return each invalid one in `not_filed` with its repair. A `quote` without a `rule` is filed as a note and the decision files without it. A phase resolves by its number, its label (e.g. `s24`) or a case-folded name. An `initiative` equal to the session's home is accepted; a different one still rejects the whole write and names `sofar_start_session`. The CLI `session_ended` follows the session's home. Per-entry filing replaces the all-or-nothing write-back tested under r1-fixes D10 and memory-lead D3.
over: All-or-nothing write-back (one bad entry files nothing; round 4 lost 2 Claude and 3 Codex write-backs this way), or filing a cross-initiative write in the home (which would misfile it)
because: Hotfix U6 (r4-fixes D2), built on hotfix/u4 09ae9b47. The 5 round-4 rejected payloads now file with 0 "nothing was filed". The builder raised the finer rulings for the record.
